A subcritical value above the plateau and above the zero-time limit forces an interior maximum. The superlevel sets of the ratio as b increases to its supremum escape to infinity for δ≤0 and shrink to the finite tie point for δ>0. For z=1/t, stationarity after clearing the denominator has leading terms Lε+2rδz/L for δ<0 and Lε-6ar²z²/L for δ=0. The remaining terms are respectively O(εz+z²) and O(εz+z³), so the displayed coefficients apply to every maximizing sequence.
